rationale: The exact incremental Direct-J/K implementation (#990/#1579) remains opt-in. The reduced #1598 historical capsule retains one matched 384-AO RHF baseline/incremental round: incremental prepared-plan cold execution (setup excluded, cold arrays absent) is about 41% slower and warm E/F is 103% slower; all three retained warm independent-reference and matched-arm numerical pairs pass. Seven additional final outcomes record unsuccessful retried 192/768-AO points, but missing per-attempt diagnostics do not establish their failure cause or baseline success. Other successful campaign records are not retained here; the earlier reported 96-AO cold gain rules out a blanket claim that every endpoint loses. UHF/moved populations were incomplete and KS acceptance was not established. Invalid retained quartet work counters cannot certify a bounded-resource guard. This is scoped historical negative evidence, not a complete default-promotion qualification. The route remains available to the narrower KS/PBE0 owner #2053.
revisit_condition: Reopen promotion only after provider-owned bounded-streaming admitted/rejected work accounting exists and a candidate guard domain shows matched complete-endpoint wins across cold, warm and moved-geometry RHF/UHF populations with unchanged numerical gates, repeated interleaved timing, exact source/library/device identity, and compile/artifact reuse cost charged to admission; or if a materially different late-SCF work distribution reopens the economics.
